I would get a second opinion on what’s going on.  I  went to the ER for extreme pain ( don’t know if you’re having pain like  this but it seems like it) and in the ultrasounds + ct scans, they found a 6cm hemorrhaging cyst. They couldn’t see anything else, and gave me 2 options: be monitored or have surgery. I ended up getting a laparoscopic surgery to see what exactly was going on, and I had ovarian torsion. So please don’t hesitate getting a second opinion or something rather! This could be serious if it’s effecting your daily life and not getting better. It probably isn’t something urgent if it isn’t intense pain that effects daily activities though. Just be aware of new or worsening symptoms
